TenantEntitlementResponseModel.description: Represents an entitlement and its capacity, pay-as-you-go and licensed policy details for a tenant.

productCategories.description: The entitlement product categories (e.g., D365Apps, Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate).

metadata.description: Additional metadata such as Feature, ProductName and nonBillableConsumed for MCSMessages.

TenantEnvironmentResourceSnapshotRespons.description: Per-resource snapshot for a tenant-scoped, all-environments listing.

metadata.description: Additional metadata such as Feature, ProductName and nonBillableConsumed for MCSMessages.

environmentId.description: The environment this resource belongs to.

users.description: The list of users associated with the tenant.

resources.description: The list of resources associated with the tenant.

entitlementAllocationsAvailable.description: Availability of the entitlements for the scope.

entitlementId.description: Entitlement ID associated with the resource.

environmentId.description: Unique identifier for the environment associated with the resource.

stopResource.description: Indicates whether the user has selected to stop the resource explicitly or not. If 'true' the resource is in a disabled state.

limit.description: The limit set for the resource consumption.

stopIfOverCapacity.description: Indicates whether to stop consuming the capacity if the resource exceeds its limit.

notifyIfOverCapacity.description: Indicates whether to notify when the resource consumption reaches its notification threshold.

notificationThreshold.description: The threshold percentage for sending notifications about resource consumption.

createdOn.description: The UTC date and time when the resource threshold configuration was first created.

NeptuneOperationResult.description: The result of a Neptune operation.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the operation result.

isErrorResult.description: Indicates whether the operation result represents an error.

EntitlementReservedResponseModel.description: The reserved allocation for an entitlement within a scope.

ReservedModel.description: The reserved quantity and unit for an entitlement.

EnvironmentEntitlementResponseModel.description: An entitlement and its capacity/pay-as-you-go details scoped to a single environment, including environment metadata.

productCategories.description: The entitlement product categories (e.g., D365Apps, Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate).

isManagedEnvironment.description: Indicates whether the environment is a managed environment.

location.description: The geographic location of the environment.

addons.description: The BAP addons attached to the environment.

permissions.description: The BAP permissions on the environment.

cleanupOpportunitySize.description: The total storage in bytes that could be reclaimed.

recommendationCount.description: The number of active cleanup recommendations.

EnvironmentEntitlementDetailServiceModel.description: The entitlement capacity and pay-as-you-go details for an environment-scoped entitlement.

EnvironmentCapacityEntitlementModel.description: The capacity entitlement for an environment scope.

EnvironmentAddonResponseModel.description: A BAP addon attached to an environment.

EnvironmentPermissionResponseModel.description: A BAP permission on an environment.

EnvironmentDisasterRecoveryState.description: The disaster recovery state of the environment.

EnvironmentDisasterRecoveryLocation.description: The disaster recovery location of the environment.

CurrencyType.description: The currency (capacity) type for an addon.

AllocationEnforcementRuleTypes.description: The type of an allocation enforcement rule.

currencyAllocations.description: Specify the request body with environment ID and currency details.
